sources: https://parks.oc.gov/oneill (ocparks.com redirects here; read 2026-11-27): 'Camping: Year-round, check-out at 12 p.m., check-in at 2 p.m.'; 'The Arroyo campground offers 79 campsites varying in size to accommodate RVs or tent camping for up to eight people per site. Reservations for individual sites can be made online, by phone or in person. The park offers eight large group campsites ... and five equestrian campsites'; 'Trabuco and Hickey Creeks also meander through the park, flowing in winter and early spring, dry in summer and fall.'; amenities 'Dump Station', 'RV Camping', 'Showers'; 'Phone: 949-923-2260 or 949-923-2256'

https://parks.oc.gov/about-us/oc-parks-fees/camping-fees (read 2026-11-27): 'Following fees are per night/per single RV, car or truck ... maximum of eight people per site. Regular: $20; Senior/Persons with disabilities: $15 ...; Utility hook-ups: $6; Second motorized vehicle (RV, car or truck) at campsite: $5'; 'Use of dump station by non-camper: $6'

https://parks.oc.gov/reservations-permits/make-reservation/reservations-faqs (read 2026-11-27): 'Reservations can be made 12 months in advance, with the booking window opening on the first of each month.'; reservation link https://oc.usedirect.com/OrangeCountyWeb/Default.aspx (UseDirect; site list not readable without navigating the JS app)

https://parks.oc.gov/about-us/park-rules/camping-park-rules (read 2026-11-27): 'The maximum number of motorized vehicles per campsite is two'; 'A $5 per night fee will be assessed for the second vehicle upon check-in'; 'Camping stays at Caspers Wilderness Park and O’Neill Regional Park are limited to a combined total of 14 nights per 30 day period at either or both parks combined'

O'Neill Regional Park Campground Map.pdf (parks.oc.gov, 2021-04): Arroyo Campground sites 1-79 in a strip between Trabuco Canyon Road and Trabuco Creek, 'Restroom & Shower' buildings, 'Trailer Sanitary Station' near the entry; no hookup sites marked. Park brochure (2021): 'Among the 78 individual campsites are several restroom buildings that include hot showers.'

Esri World_Imagery 500 m and 1 km frames at 33.6531,-117.6003 / 33.6545,-117.5960 (read 2026-11-27): stored pin at the park entry road junction; Arroyo loops run ~1 km NE in oak/sycamore woodland, the Trabuco Creek bed beside them a dry sand-and-gravel wash

sites.source: parks.oc.gov/oneill ('The Arroyo campground offers 79 campsites'), read 2026-11-27

hookups.source: Derived 'no hookups' not supported by any page read 2026-11-27: the OC Parks fee schedule lists 'Utility hook-ups: $6' for the two camping parks, the campground map marks no hookup sites, and the reservation system's site list could not be read. Cleared to unknown.

facilities.source: parks.oc.gov/oneill amenities ('Dump Station', 'Showers') + campground map ('Restroom & Shower', 'Trailer Sanitary Station'), read 2026-11-27

values.note: Seniors 60+ and visitors with disabilities $15. The county schedule also lists a $6 utility hookup charge.

fees.source: parks.oc.gov camping-fees page ('Regular: $20'; 'Senior/Persons with disabilities: $15'; 'Utility hook-ups: $6'; 'Second motorized vehicle ... $5'; 'maximum of eight people per site') + camping park rules ('maximum number of motorized vehicles per campsite is two'), read 2026-11-27

values.note: The 12-month window opens on the first of each month.

booking.source: parks.oc.gov reservations FAQ ('Reservations can be made 12 months in advance, with the booking window opening on the first of each month.') + make-reservation page (oc.usedirect.com link) + camping park rules (14 nights per 30 days), read 2026-11-27

note: OC Parks campground in oak and sycamore woodland along Trabuco Creek (dry in summer and fall) in Trabuco Canyon. Sites vary in size; group and equestrian camps are separate. Nights here and at Caspers Wilderness Park share one 14-night limit per 30 days. --Claude
summary: parks.oc.gov park, fee, FAQ and rules pages + 2021 campground map + imagery read. 79 individual sites, showers, dump, year-round, $20 ($15 seniors), $5 second vehicle, reservable 12 months ahead on UseDirect, 14 nights per 30 days. Hookups cleared to unknown (fee schedule lists a $6 hookup charge; no page says none). Pin ~407 m from the campground's middle. Not waterfront unchanged. Phone unchanged.
